Subject: Your maritime salvage claim matter - A.S. No. 873/2024

Dear Ms. Mittal,

Thank you for meeting us on 3 January 2025 about your dispute with Zenith Shipping Pvt Ltd. As we understand it, the vessel is about to leave port. The matter is listed before the Gujarat High Court.

Our advice is to arrest the vessel to secure the salvage claim. Please collect the salvage agreement and the logbook entries and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Rohit Wadhwa
